notes.title: News and Updates
notes.content:
We just put out another update!

Whats new:

- Optimization (should run a lot better now with less resources)
- First levels now "walk you through" how to start the game
- Minor bug fixes

Keep an eye on the announcements in the next month or so for some new content! We're currently working on some SEASONAL themed things :D

notes.title: First Update
notes.content:
We just pushed a minor update! This added the difficulty settings right onto the front menu and a couple other minor changes. New stuff is in the works, so keep an eye out!

-TooManyBugs
